source: Written for pshe/y2 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 9: Where does chocolate come from? Cocoa farmers and fair trade. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

timeline.text: Beans are taken out and dried in the sun

panels.title: What is fair?
points: They should be paid enough to live

panels.title: The fair trade mark
points: Means farmers got a fair price
Look for it with a grown-up

blocks.text: Draw each step (objects and places only).

keywords.def: a person who grows cocoa trees
farmers are paid a fair price
the fruit with cocoa beans inside

questions.q: Put in order: factory, tree, ship, shop.
Pupil PDF: draw the journey of chocolate in four boxes (objects and places only).
questions.a: Four boxes: tree, ship, factory, shop.

questions.q: Review: say one thing you learned this half term about food.
questions.a: For example: we say Bismillah; halal and tayyib; fair trade.

questions.q: What does the fair trade mark tell us?
questions.a: A) Farmers were paid fairly. Fair trade means a fair price for the farmers.

questions.q: Think again: If a farmer works hard all year but is paid only a tiny amount, is that fair? What could we do?
questions.a: It is not fair. We can choose fair trade products so farmers get a fair price.
